mechanism: A calm paper page on which the real product floats as dark devices: the house screen and the relative's phone. The only saturated green on the whole site is the moment someone is confirmed safe.

candidates.chosen: Línea en calma: warm paper ground, near-black green ink, dark device surfaces, one signal green spent on 'a salvo'.
rejected: Noche de la llamada (full-dark site with green glow): reads as one more dark AI-security SaaS, and the dark product panels would vanish into a dark page.
Cartel cívico (riso poster, Mexican color blocks): makes a crime that terrifies grandparents look festive, is harder to read under stress, and buries the one green moment among many colors.

signature_move: The hero is the product running: a scripted call types into the house screen, the stage track lights up, Ana's phone asks '¿Estás bien?', she taps yes and the house screen floods green. Spent once on the landing; /demo is the same thing for real.

tokens.accent_rule: senal (green) only means 'safe': the a-salvo screen, the 'connected' dot, the brand dot. alerta and peligro only appear inside product UI to show call states. Primary CTA is a tinta pill with papel text.
tokens.shadow: One soft drop shadow, only on floating devices: 0 30px 60px -20px rgb(14 20 17 / 0.45). Everything else is flat.

motion.policy: CSS keyframes and transitions only, every entrance behind motion-safe; loops stop under prefers-reduced-motion

brand.name: cuelga (lowercase wordmark)
brand.mark: A handset drawn as a bold C, with a signal-green dot in its mouth: the call, and the person confirmed safe. Ink on paper, paper on night. Never green handset on its own: that reads as WhatsApp.
brand.voice: Calm, short, imperative when it matters. Never says pay, deposit or negotiate.
